ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro-ratio with approximately 95% low-intensity (black) pixels and 5% high-intensity (white) pixels localized to distal margins and specular reflections.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominantly solid black pigmentation. A high-contrast contiguous white and grey mottled patch is located at the distal tip of the left lobe trailing edge. Scattered high-intensity white punctate marks are distributed across the ventral surface plane.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central notch with an approximate opening angle of 135 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration. Left lobe features broad, rounded peaks. Right lobe features sharper, more frequent valleys, including a significant irregular cleft approximately 65% distal from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical upward convex curve. Left lobe terminates in a blunt, rounded vertical tip. Right lobe terminates in a sharper, tapered lateral tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of approximately 6-8 circular high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle scars) localized on the outer margin of the left lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible cluster of circular white scars on the distal left lobe. Macro-level irregular jagged notch on the right lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized high-contrast white pigmentation patch on the trailing edge of the left lobe tip.
